title: Sources
hint: Drag files or folders to the queue. Ctrl/Shift-click to select several.
addTitle: Double-click or drag to add to queue
dirTitle: Double-click to open · drag it to add every video inside
dropUploadHere: Drop to upload into this folder
uploadTitle: Upload videos from this computer into the open folder

watch.watchedTitle: New videos in this folder are added to the queue by themselves. Click for the settings.
watch.watchedOffTitle: A watch folder, but watching is off in Settings
watch.watchTitle: Add new videos that appear in this folder to the queue by themselves

protectedTitle: This sources folder is protected: its files can't be deleted from the app. Change it in Settings → Folders.
downloadTitle: Download the selected files and folders to this computer
empty: No folders or video files here.
excludedTitle: Matches an exclude pattern; skipped when adding a folder
